CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: The Allstate Corporation (NYSE: ALL) protects people from life's uncertainties with affordable, simple and connected protection for autos, homes, electronic devices and identities. Products are available through a broad distribution network including Allstate agents, independent agents, major retailers, online and at the workplace. Allstate has 216 million policies in force and is widely known for the slogan 'You're in Good Hands with Allstate.' For more information, visit www.allstate.com.
